meta.title: Wheel of Career Assessment
meta.description: A structured self-assessment framework that evaluates 8 key dimensions of career health. This tool helps you reflect on your current career status, identify strengths and development areas, and support career coaching, mentoring, and development conversations.
meta.privacyNotice: This assessment is designed for personal career reflection and development. Your responses will be used to generate your Wheel of Career result. Individual results will not be shared unless a formal data storage and access process is approved and clearly communicated.
meta.disclaimer: The Wheel of Career Assessment is a self-reflection and development tool. It is not a formal performance evaluation and should not be used as the sole basis for promotion, compensation, or employment decisions.

questions.text: I clearly understand what is expected from me in my current role.
I understand how my role contributes to the broader goals of the organization.

options.label: A
options.text: I do not understand the connection

options.label: C
options.text: I understand some of the connection

questions.text: My responsibilities and decision-making authority are clearly defined.
I know which priorities matter most in my role.
My manager or stakeholders provide clear direction when needed.

insights.high: You appear to have strong clarity about your role, expectations, and priorities. Continue aligning regularly with your manager and stakeholders to maintain this clarity.
insights.medium: Your role clarity is generally good, but there may be areas where expectations, priorities, or decision rights can be sharpened.
insights.low: Role clarity may need attention. Consider discussing your mandate, priorities, and decision rights with your manager.

questions.text: I deliver results that clearly contribute to business outcomes.
My work has measurable impact.
I consistently meet or exceed my performance objectives.
I focus my effort on work that creates real value.
My achievements are visible to relevant stakeholders.

insights.high: Your work appears to create clear and measurable impact. Continue focusing on outcomes that matter to the business.
insights.medium: You are contributing value, but there may be opportunities to make your impact more measurable or more visible.
insights.low: Performance and impact may need stronger focus. Consider clarifying your objectives and identifying the outcomes that matter most.

questions.text: I have the skills required to perform my current role effectively.
I am actively developing new capabilities for future career needs.
I keep myself updated on trends, tools, and practices relevant to my field.
I receive or seek useful feedback to improve my capabilities.
I can confidently handle complex challenges in my area of work.

insights.high: You appear confident in your current capabilities and actively prepared for future needs. Continue investing in future-facing skills.
insights.medium: Your capabilities are generally strong, but there may be specific skills that require further development.
insights.low: Skills and capability may need focused development. Consider creating a learning plan for the capabilities most relevant to your role and future path.

questions.text: I have a clear view of my next career step.
I understand what is required to progress to the next level.
I am getting opportunities that prepare me for future roles.
I feel my career is progressing at a healthy pace.
I have meaningful development conversations about my career.

insights.high: You appear to have a clear and healthy career growth path. Continue seeking opportunities that prepare you for your next step.
insights.medium: Your career growth direction is forming, but additional clarity or development conversations may help.
insights.low: Career growth may need attention. Consider discussing your next step, required competencies, and development opportunities with your manager or mentor.

questions.text: I am trusted by others to lead or influence important work.
I can influence decisions beyond my direct responsibilities.
I communicate my ideas with clarity and confidence.
I demonstrate ownership and accountability in my work.
I am seen as someone who can guide, support, or inspire others.

insights.high: You appear to have strong leadership presence and influence. Continue using this strength to guide work and support others.
insights.medium: You have a foundation of leadership and influence, but there may be opportunities to increase visibility, ownership, or stakeholder impact.
insights.low: Leadership and influence may need development. Consider opportunities to lead initiatives, communicate ideas, and build trust across stakeholders.

questions.text: I have strong working relationships with key stakeholders.
I have access to mentors, sponsors, or trusted advisors.
I collaborate effectively with colleagues across teams.
I maintain a professional network that supports my growth.
People are willing to support me when I need help or alignment.

insights.high: You appear to have a strong professional network and healthy stakeholder relationships. Continue nurturing these relationships.
insights.medium: Your relationships are generally healthy, but your network could be expanded or made more strategic.
insights.low: Network and relationships may need focused attention. Consider identifying key stakeholders, mentors, or sponsors who can support your growth.

questions.text: I feel fairly compensated for my contribution.
My contributions are recognized by my manager or stakeholders.
I feel appreciated for the value I bring.
Rewards, promotions, or recognition feel aligned with performance.
I receive recognition in ways that motivate me.

insights.high: You appear to feel fairly recognized and rewarded for your contribution. Continue documenting achievements and maintaining visibility.
insights.medium: Recognition and rewards appear acceptable, but there may be room to improve visibility, feedback, or alignment with performance.
insights.low: Compensation and recognition may need attention. Consider discussing expectations, achievements, and recognition with your manager through the appropriate channels.

questions.text: My workload is manageable.
I can maintain good energy and focus throughout the workweek.
My work allows enough time for recovery and personal wellbeing.
I can deliver quality work without constant pressure or overload.
My current work pace is sustainable over the long term.

insights.high: Your workload appears manageable and sustainable. Continue protecting your energy and maintaining healthy work practices.
insights.medium: Your workload may be manageable most of the time, but there may be periods of pressure that require better prioritization or support.
insights.low: Workload and sustainability may need immediate attention. Consider reviewing priorities, workload balance, and support mechanisms with your manager.

reflectionQuestions: Which 2 areas scored the highest, and what helped make them strong?
Which 2 areas scored the lowest, and why?
What is one area I want to improve over the next 90 days?
What support do I need from my manager, mentor, or stakeholders?
What is one action I can start this week?
Which strength can I use to improve a weaker area?
